_comment: ml-commons CONNECTOR blueprint -- this is CONFIGURATION, not code. Register it against a running cluster (./gradlew run) with: POST /_plugins/_ml/connectors/_create  (body = this file, minus _comment fields). It returns a connector_id you paste into 02_flow_agent.json. The built-in ConnectorTool uses this blueprint to make the HTTP call to the agent server's /generate_dsl. No Java is written.
name: Agentic Search Remote DSL Connector
description: Calls the agent server's non-streaming /generate_dsl endpoint to translate NLQ -> OpenSearch DSL.
_comment_parameters: Defaults merged into every request; ${parameters.endpoint} is substituted into the url below. Set endpoint to the agent server's host.
_comment_credential: POC: a static bearer token. Secrets MUST be referenced as ${credential.*} (ml-commons blocks ${parameters.*} in security headers like Authorization). ml-commons encrypts the credential map at rest.

actions._comment_action: ConnectorTool drives the EXECUTE path, but predict is the standard action_type and shares the same createPayload/processOutput pipeline.
actions._comment_request_body: Templated from the params ml-commons passes the tool. neural-search puts the NLQ in 'question' and the index in 'index_name' (see MLCommonsClientAccessor). These ${parameters.*} are filled at call time.
actions._comment_post_process: THE KEY LINE. The built-in mlcommons.passthrough function reads output[0].result from our inference_results envelope and copies it into ModelTensor.result -- the only field neural-search's extractFlowAgentResult reads. Without this, the DSL would land in dataAsMap and the FLOW agent would fail with 'did not return valid DSL query'. No painless script needed.
